tests.description: Canonical parse succeeds for an already normalized VERS.
Parsing fails when ASCII whitespace is present.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: whitespace is not permitted

tests.description: Parsing fails when constraints start with a pipe.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: leading pipe is not permitted

tests.description: Parsing fails when constraints end with a pipe.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: trailing pipe is not permitted

tests.description: Parsing fails when constraints contain consecutive pipes.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: consecutive pipes are not permitted

tests.description: Parsing fails when constraints are not in canonical order.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: constraints are not sorted by version

tests.description: Parsing decodes canonical percent-encoding once for versions.
Parsing accepts percent-encoded SPACE in a version.
Parsing accepts percent-encoded TAB in a version.
Parsing fails when literal ASCII whitespace occurs in a version.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: whitespace is not permitted

tests.description: Validation recommends percent-encoding SPACE in a version.
Parsing fails when version percent-encoding is invalid.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: invalid percent-encoding in version

tests.description: Parsing fails for datetime when lowercase t and z are used.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: datetime must use uppercase T and Z

tests.description: Parsing fails for datetime when time colons are percent-encoded.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: datetime time colons must be unencoded

tests.description: Parsing fails for datetime when percent-encoding is invalid.
tests.expected_message: non-canonical VERS: invalid percent-encoding in version

tests.description: Parsing fails for datetime when percent-encoded triplets use non-canonical hex case.
